text:
maya: Ran the nightly perf suite for fused-attn + TP with KV prefetch enabled. Observed a sharp tail latency increase for long sequences (6k-8k) when effective batch > 16. attaching quick logs below.

liam: ugh. rough. did you run with chunked all-reduce or the default small-grain?

maya: default. command was: `./run_perf.sh --model zeta-v2 --tp 4 --pipeline 1 --kv-prefetch true --batch-size 32 --seq-len 8192`

arjun: can you paste the perf summary? thinking comm/compute overlap broke because prefetch moved memcpy points earlier.

maya: perf-bot reported this after the run:
```
perf-bot: nightly-perf job 579432 completed. summary: p95 latency +2.3x, p99 +2.7x for seq>=6k, throughput -18% for batch>16
nvprof snippet: cudaMemcpy H2D peaks aligned with all-reduce start; CUDA kernels idle between 3.2s-3.7s
allreduce micro: 4x small messages (256KB) instead of 1 big 1MB; net bw inefficient
```

arjun: that matches my theory — prefetch created extra KV scatter windows so QKV all-gather got fragmented. smaller all-reduce messages => bad throughput on our NVLink mesh.

eva: also saw a regression on kernel picker logs: fallback to slow bf16 kernel for attention when prefetch is on (presumably due to alignment). snippet: `kernel_picker: chosen=fused_attn_bf16_slow path`

liam: two actionable items: 1) try `--kv-prefetch false` to repro inverse and confirm regression. 2) enable `--allreduce-chunking=1` (force larger message coalesce) and re-run.

maya: re-ran with kv-prefetch=false and chunking=1. results: p95 back to normal, throughput restored. with kv-prefetch=true + chunking=1, tail still +15% but much better than +130%.

arjun: suggests a heuristic: if seq_len>4096 and tp>1 then disable prefetch or increase chunk_coalesce threshold in runtime. Also add a kernel-selection probe at startup to detect alignment changes that force bf16 fallback.

maya: putting that as a TODO in the perf ticket. quick patch idea: when prefetch enabled, group kvcache ops into single all-gather per layer instead of per-shard scatter. may reduce concurrency but should improve bandwidth utilization.

eva: +1. we should also log `allreduce_msg_sizes` in the console dashboard for per-route telemetry so we can catch regressions early.

perf-bot: created ticket INF-4821: "TP fused-attn: KV-prefetch causes all-reduce fragmentation and bf16 kernel fallback on long sequences" linking logs /jobs/579432 and nvprof tarball.

liam: for short term: default config change for hosted: set `kv_prefetch=false` for routes with tp>1 and seq_len>4096. we can rollback when heuristic landed.

maya: noted. will draft a canary config and run on dedicated cluster tomorrow morning. thanks all :thumbsup:
